h1: ♅ Uranus in Astrology: Change • Freedom • Breakthroughs
subtitle: Domicile: Aquarius • Exaltation: Scorpio (modern)
summary: Uranus is the modern ruler of Aquarius and symbolizes innovation, liberation, and sudden change. In the natal chart, its sign, house, and aspects reveal where you crave independence, disrupt norms, and experience breakthroughs. Its transits—spending about seven years in each sign—bring shocks that catalyze reinvention in the house it activates, often through technology, rebellion, or unexpected twists. When retrograde, Uranus internalizes the urge for freedom, prompting you to dismantle outdated patterns and realign with authentic choices.

sections.heading: Personality Snapshot
sections.html:
Uranus is your breaker box: the circuit flips when a system is stale. Fed well, it’s clean disruption and future-fit ideas. Starved, it throws chaos for novelty’s sake.

✅ What it wants

  • Freedom to try a different path
  • Systems that serve people (not the other way)
  • Honest weirdness, ethical innovation

⚠️ When it struggles

  • Rebellion as a personality, not a tool
  • Shock value over substance
  • Ghosting commitments at the first constraint

🧭 Feed it well

  • Prototype > pontificate (timebox experiments)
  • Keep promises that protect freedom
  • Join communities that love your odd edges

sections.heading: Returns & Cycles (21/42/63/84 milestones)
sections.html:
Uranus return & opposition

  • Return ≈ age 84: radical renewal
  • Opposition ≈ age 42: mid-life jailbreak vibes
  • Squares ≈ 21 & 63: course-corrections

Retrograde rhythm

  • ~5 months each year
  • Update tech/process; detach from stale rules
  • Watch clashes like Uranus square Saturn

House focus

  • Track which house Uranus activates
  • Prototype loudly in the 11th; edit roots under the 4th
  • Blend with your sign tone
